replicate_transport.recovery: One cached SAM prediction per requested scene, shared across selected people; no depth rerun and no private GPU fallback
replicate_transport.recovery_difference: The tested Replicate wrapper accepts text prompts only. Its retry reruns person detection within the selected shot and selects the mask at the saved tap; our-worker recovery uses point-prompt tracking. Neither invents a mask when the tap is missed.
replicate_transport.durability: Persist prediction intent before paid POST; resume known prediction ID; ambiguous POST blocks a duplicate create; verified outputs reused; renew expired or unknown-expiry unconsumed file uploads before submission
replicate_transport.runtime: Per-task preparation deadline plus Cancel-After on every prediction; timeout requests cancellation
replicate_transport.cleanup: Delete Files API input after confirmed terminal prediction; retain unconfirmed/running input until safe cleanup or provider expiry
replicate_transport.logs: Provider, operation, IDs, model, upload bytes/time, predict/total time and bounded transfer timings; no keys, media URLs or provider traceback bodies
